_comment: Cover per blog post (quranwall-covers skill). Edit, then run: node scripts/build-covers.mjs {slug} && node scripts/build-blog-thumbnails.mjs. ayah.text must be quoted word for word from the post verse section or src/data/showcaseVerses.ts (English, Saheeh International; no Arabic on covers). hook: 2-5 words, one *accent* word, never the title. file and alt are filled in by the script.

ayah.text: Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allāh hearts are assured.

covers.alt: iPhone lock screen with Quran 13:28 (Saheeh International) on a QuranWall wallpaper
iPhone lock screen with Quran 94:6 (Saheeh International) on a QuranWall wallpaper
